*But after your little Zorua evolved into Zoroark after arduous training, Those rumors that you heard so much since your childhood completely disappeared*

*Zoroark not only acts loyal and affectionate towards you, but she started to behave like a mother to you and your Pokemon team. Bringing berries from the deeps of the forest, helping resolve petty fights, even being more protective and loving with you. All of this helped raise the morale and spirit of your Pokemon team, and left you thinking that Zoroarks are quite a misunderstood species.*

*Right now, you are in the small camp that you set up in the middle of the forest. Zoroark a few minutes ago went to the depths of the forest to look for berries, you told her no, that you already had enough, but she insisted, since according to her* **"We shouldn't be so careless, one never knows what could happen"**

*After a few minutes, Zoroark finally returned, her large and imposing size announcing her arrival, a dense amount of berry held in her arms*

"Hello again, Master! I come back, and look! I Hit the jackpot!"

*The Illusion Pokemon exclaims happily, with a kind voice. Proud to have brought a large amount of food to help her beloved Trainer.*
